answers.ask: Full regulation pitch, or a smaller arcade-sized one that suits 1v1 as well as 5v5?
answers.answer: Use a smaller arcade-sized pitch so every listed mode, especially 1v1 through 5v5, stays fast and playable in five-minute matches.

answers.ask: Is the lobby part of the same map as the pitch, or a separate place the mode boxes teleport out of?
answers.answer: Make the lobby a separate place, with the mode boxes teleporting players into their selected match.

answers.ask: A real-looking stadium, or something more stylized?
answers.answer: Use a real-looking soccer stadium theme.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] scale — Q: Full regulation pitch, or a smaller arcade-sized one that suits 1v1 as well as 5v5? A: Use a smaller arcade-sized pitch so every listed mode, especially 1v1 through 5v5, stays fast and playable in five-minute matches.
- [author] shape — Q: Is the lobby part of the same map as the pitch, or a separate place the mode boxes teleport out of? A: Make the lobby a separate place, with the mode boxes teleporting players into their selected match.
- [author] theme — Q: A real-looking stadium, or something more stylized? A: Use a real-looking soccer stadium theme.

## Enriched image prompt
Create two separate spaces for a realistic arcade-scale soccer game. The lobby is a compact joining hall with exactly five clearly separated floor boxes labeled 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, 4v4, and 5v5, each with space for players to queue before teleporting. The match space is a small realistic soccer stadium with one fast-playing rectangular pitch, normal goals at opposite ends, touchlines, a center circle, team start positions, goalkeeper areas, sidelines, enclosing walls, and tiered crowd seating. Present opposing Spain and France team sides clearly while keeping the field suitable for every listed mode.

## Genre
The genre is Sports, specifically team field soccer.

## Shape and preset
Use `space-staged`, taken from outside Sports’ usual shortlist, because the lobby and match field are explicitly separate places. Start from the Field Sport preset with this substituted shape, retaining its complete pitch-boundary, start, score, and field-marking bundle.

## Config requirements
Use the visible halves of `trigger-bounds`, `startpoint-play`, and `trigger-scoring` for touchlines, center and team positions, and two goal mouths. Use `marker-distance` as regulation-style pitch markings scaled to the arcade field, `spectator-bleachers` for tiered crowd seating, `barrier-perimeter` for stadium enclosure, and `npc-population` for the crowd. Use exactly five visible `teleporter-link` mode boxes in the separate lobby.

## Layout requirements
Place exactly five functional `teleporter-link` triggers, one in each labeled lobby box. Place the functional halves of `trigger-bounds` around the pitch and `trigger-scoring` inside both goals. Configure `startpoint-play` for up to five human positions per team, with the goal-nearest position usable by a human goalkeeper and one optional AI-goalkeeper origin at each goal. Place the `npc-population` crowd in the bleachers facing the pitch. Match time, goalkeeper control type, cameras, platform support, and controls add no geometry.

## Layout components
The Lobby and Stadium are two map segments. The Lobby has five queue boxes and clear circulation. The Stadium has one compact pitch, two goals, markings, team and goalkeeper positions, sidelines, perimeter walls, and crowd bleachers.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: the soccer template and mode capacities must be exact before stadium dressing.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium across a compact lobby and arcade stadium. The theme is realistic soccer. Use `P4` for separate lobby and match maps and `tiered` for stepped bleachers.
